query: Given this restaurant opening hours string: 12:00 PM - 2:30 PM, 7:00 PM - 10:30 PM, open on Mondays, Tuesdays, Thursdays, Fridays. Determine if the restaurant is typically OPEN for both lunch (around 12:00-15:00) and dinner (around 18:00-22:00) on its normal operating days. Respond with open_for_lunch_and_dinner True if both are typically available, else False.
